title: Gradual rollout rewind notes
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for the partial rollout that needed a rewind on 2025-10-09 -> 2025-10-12. Use this to capture commands run, odd outputs, hypotheses, and a minimal sop to avoid repeating the same trap. Intention is: handwritten breadcrumbs for on-call + follow-up RCA.

Summary (short):
- Trigger: staged rollout of platform-service v2.7.0 -> traffic split 5/95 (new/old) at 2025-10-09 09:12 PDT.
- Symptoms: increased 503s for downstream /openai-proxy path, flakey websocket attachments, periodic spikes in tail latency for 95/99p. Canary initially green for health checks but real traffic showed errors within ~30 mins.
- Action taken: paused rollout, then attempted automated rollback -> some pods failed to pull image, revealed artifact tag -> digest mismatch issue. Ended up pinning to explicit digest (sha256:...), scaled old replica set back to desired count, restored traffic.

Timeline + commands (chronological):
- 2025-10-09 09:12 PDT: kickoff rollout via argo/helm chart update (ci artifact tag v2.7.0)
  Command: helm upgrade platform-service ./charts/platform-service --set image.tag=v2.7.0 --namespace platform

- 09:41 PDT: Alerts: /proxy 5xx rate > baseline, 95p latency +200ms. Slack alert: #oncall
  Quick check: kubectl get pods -n platform -l app=platform-service -o wide
  Observed: new pods on gke-n1-highmem-8-3 showing Ready=1/2 for several minutes

- 09:43 PDT: inspected logs
  kubectl logs -n platform deploy/platform-service -c platform --since=15m | grep -i "ERROR\\|WARN" | head
  Output snippet:
    2025-10-09T09:42:11Z WARN upstream response timed out after 20s for route=/openai-proxy
    2025-10-09T09:42:17Z ERROR attach session failed: websocket: close 1006 (abnormal closure)

- 09:50 PDT: execute health queries against canary pod (pod/ps-2f8c)
  kubectl exec -n platform pod/ps-2f8c -- curl -sS -D - http://localhost:8080/health
  Output: HTTP/1.1 200 OK (liveness), but /metrics showed higher retry_count and queue_depth

- 10:05 PDT: Attempt to pause rollout (Argo):
  argo rollouts pause platform-service -n platform --revision=v2.7.0
  -> response: paused
  But errors continued for real traffic. Decided to roll back to v2.6.3

- 10:12 PDT: Try automated rollback via kubectl
  kubectl rollout undo deployment/platform-service -n platform --to-revision=12
  Observed: ReplicaSet r12 -> started scale down of r13 (v2.7.0), started creating pods for r12
  BUT several pods failed with CrashLoopBackOff and ImagePullBackOff. Logs:
    Warning  Failed     3s (x4 over 1m)  kubelet            Failed to pull image "gcr.io/redwood/platform-service:v2.7.0": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch "sha256:abc..." from remote: digest mismatch

- 10:20 PDT: Hypothesis: Tag v2.7.0 has been reassigned in registry during rollout window or registry garbage collection mutated manifests -> digest mismatch for some nodes. Also possible race between CI pushing image and tag propagation across multi-region registries.

Investigation steps executed (commands + notes):
- Verified tags and digests in registry (gcr):
  gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood/platform-service --filter="tags:v2.7.0" --format=json | jq '.[0].digest'
  Observed two different digests reported from different control-plane endpoints (us-west1 vs us-central1 queries showed different sha256 values) -> strong sign of eventual consistency mismatch in registry mirrors.

- Pulled exact digest locally to validate image content:
  docker pull gcr.io/redwood/platform-service@sha256:abc123...
  docker inspect gcr.io/redwood/platform-service@sha256:abc123... | jq '.[0].RepoDigests'
  -> sample content matched the image we pushed from CI (artifact builder job #874)

- Checked CI job that pushed v2.7.0 (GH Actions build-and-push #874):
  GH Action log: uploaded image with digest sha256:abc123... then tagged as v2.7.0. Unexpectedly, artifact builder re-run job #882 (retry) also pushed a different build and re-tagged v2.7.0 -> produced sha256:def456... This looks like root cause: re-tagging same semver after a rebuild.
  Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421

- Killed autoscaler on the canary pool temporarily to prevent mixed-image nodes from scheduling (gke node pools had hetero caches) -> cordon nodes that showed old/different image content
  kubectl cordon gke-node-07

Remediation performed (ordered):
1) Pause rollout and remove traffic split (feature-gateway), force 100% to stable route.
   curl -X POST $GATEWAY/admin/traffic -d '{"service":"platform-service","split":{"vstable":100,"vcanary":0}}'

2) Pin stable replica set by explicit image digest (v2.6.3@sha256:oldsha) to ensure no tag drift going forward.
   kubectl set image deployment/platform-service platform=gcr.io/redwood/platform-service@sha256:oldsha -n platform

3) Scale up pinned RS to desired count and wait for ready pods.
   kubectl scale deploy/platform-service --replicas=10 -n platform
   kubectl wait --for=condition=available deploy/platform-service -n platform --timeout=600s

4) For the next rollout, require immutable tag policy: never rely on semver tag for live swaps without digest pinning. CI change: push artifacts with sha and create release tag only after manual approval step. (TODO: write GH Action policy change)

Open questions / hypotheses to validate in RCA:
- Why was CI allowed to re-tag v2.7.0 after initial push? (GH Actions re-run semantics, unclear gating)
- Registry replication lag: how often do mirrors disagree? Is it acceptable for global clusters? Add a check in rolling job to verify digest equality across regions before continue.
- Node-local image caching: some nodes returned one digest and others another -> are we seeing stale manifest cache in Container-Registry or an intermediary CDN?
- Should we introduce a pre-rollout verification step that queries all target regions for the same digest? (propose script to gcloud list-tags per region and ensure digest parity)

Notes for immediate follow-up tasks (action items):
- [ ] Update release playbook to always include digest pin when pausing/unwinding (me)
- [ ] Add guard in GH Actions: disable re-tag on rerun; require manual tag step or create tag-only-on-success workflow (Ava)
- [ ] Add registry-digest-check step in rollout orchestration (Lina)
- [ ] Post-mortem draft (due 2025-10-15) with timeline and root cause
- [ ] Add monitoring for ImagePullBackOff spikes and digest mismatch patterns

Useful snippets to keep (copy/paste):
- Check deployed image by pod:
  kubectl get pods -n platform -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}' | tr ' ' '\\n' | sort | uniq -c

- Query registry digests:
  gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood/platform-service --format='get(digest,tags)' --limit=50

- Force set deployment to digest:
  kubectl set image deploy/platform-service platform=gcr.io/redwood/platform-service@sha256:oldsha -n platform --record

Last observed state (2025-10-12 14:03): rollout paused, stable at v2.6.3 pinned by digest, CI gating update drafted in GH branch 'release-hardening/registry-consistency'.
